raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-AFW-HealthSecurityPhase3",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Armed conflict, security instability, and population displacement in FCV areas (such as CAR, Chad, and Cameroon) may disrupt health service delivery and delay project activities.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct Security Risk Assessments (SRAs), implement Security Management Plans (SMPs), and adopt flexible implementation arrangements tailored to fragile settings.",
      "evidence": "Fragility in AFW is exacerbated by conflict and violence, leading to large population displacements."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Decentralized implementation across multiple line ministries and field-level activities creates risks of non-compliant or questionable expenditures.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Update financial management manuals, customize accounting software across PIUs, mandate internal audit work plans, and recruit independent external auditors within six months of effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "several activities under the project like workshops, trainings and the local-level capacity building are at risk to generate questionable expenditures in Cameroon."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Weak contract management capacity and restricted market competition in FCV environments could cause procurement bottlenecks and delivery delays for critical health commodities.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit qualified procurement specialists, conduct early market engagement for high-value contracts, utilize STEP real-time tracking, and apply flexible procurement methods.",
      "evidence": "Procurement Risks include delays, governance issues, weak contract management, and limited market competition in fragile settings."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Expanded diagnostic and laboratory operations will generate hazardous chemical, biological, and medical waste, posing environmental and community health risks.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Update and implement Healthcare and Biomedical Waste Management Plans (BMWMP), integrate safe storage and disposal standards, and enforce biosafety guidelines across lab networks.",
      "evidence": "laboratories will be supplied with reagents, chemicals, and equipment that may constitute medical waste once used."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Increased deployment of community health workforces and civil works labor influx heighten risks of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH).",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prepare country-specific SEA/SH Action Plans, recruit dedicated GBV specialists, establish GBV-sensitive grievance redress mechanisms, and enforce worker codes of conduct.",
      "evidence": "The overall project SEA/SH risks are judged to be substantial... lack of national protocols for the identification and care of survivors of SEA/SH"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Recurrent climate events such as floods and extreme heat threaten health facility infrastructure and increase vector- and waterborne disease outbreaks.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate green and climate-resilient designs (e.g., EDGE certification, solar power) into health facility rehabilitations and integrate early warning climate-health surveillance systems.",
      "evidence": "Climate change is a primary driver of health emergencies in Central Africa and already has negative impacts on health systems..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Vulnerable or disadvantaged groups (such as IDPs, refugees, rural women, and indigenous communities) may face structural barriers to accessing project interventions.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement adapted Stakeholder Engagement Plans (SEPs), establish accessible local Grievance Redress Mechanisms (GRMs), and target inclusive community outreach.",
      "evidence": "Potential social risks are substantial and relate to: (i) inadequate stakeholder engagement... (ii) the exclusion of vulnerable or disadvantaged groups"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Complex regional coordination across five implementing entities (CEMAC and four national governments) with differing priorities may cause operational friction and delay regional activities.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Operationalize the Regional Coordination Committee (RCC) facilitated by CEMAC/WAHO, establish formal MoUs, and utilize standardized regional platforms and protocols.",
      "evidence": "Effective coordination among CEMAC, national governments, and beneficiaries is essential for successful implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Digitization of surveillance and cross-border data sharing could expose sensitive health data to privacy breaches without robust data governance.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish standardized data-sharing protocols with strict personal data protection rules in accordance with national laws and international ethics guidelines.",
      "evidence": "inadequate attention to ensure that guidelines established under the Program include considerations for and ethical data security protocols"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Construction or rehabilitation of laboratories, health posts, and emergency centers may lead to land acquisition or localized land use restrictions.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Screen project sites during preparation and prepare site-specific Resettlement Plans (RPs) and Environmental and Social Management Plans (ESMPs) prior to civil works.",
      "evidence": "land acquisition impacts associated with new constructions"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Fiscal constraints and low domestic health spending in participating countries threaten the long-term financial sustainability of health security infrastructure post-project.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide technical assistance to integrate health security into national Medium-Term Expenditure Frameworks, track budget allocations, and explore public-private partnerships.",
      "evidence": "low government funding (driven by weak revenue generation and low prioritization of health in the government’s budget) has led to a high reliance on household’s out-of-pocket payments..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Gaps in laboratory diagnostic capacity, biosafety standards, and fragile supply chains could hinder timely pathogen identification and early warning response.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish integrated sample transport networks, deploy Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), enforce biosafety standards, and conduct SLIPTA quality audits.",
      "evidence": "the region commonly faces significant gaps in laboratory diagnostic capabilities, disease surveillance and information systems, supply chain infrastructure and management..."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Delays in recruiting key PIU staff (such as FM officers, auditors, and E&S specialists) and establishing steering committees within legal covenant deadlines could slip project timelines.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize Project Preparation Advances to initiate early recruitment and fulfill dated legal covenants for staffing and software customization.",
      "evidence": "CEMAC - Financing Agreement (Schedule 2, Section I.A.1b): The Recipient shall, not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, appoint, assign, or recruit..."
    }
  ]
}
